summary: Duplicate Advisory: PraisonAI: AgentOS defaults to network-exposed no-auth mode, allowing unauthenticated agent invocation and instruction disclosure
details:
### Duplicate Advisory
This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-6wjp-v33h-5cvq. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

### Original Description
PraisonAI before 1.7.3 contains an insecure default configuration that binds to all interfaces with no API key requirement and wildcard CORS. Unauthenticated attackers can call GET /api/agents to read agent instructions and system prompts, or POST /api/chat to invoke agents without authentication.
